conf.description: MOVEit Transfer audit, jdbc-sql: Database Collector typed columns shaped to ECS + moveit.transfer.*, same Action-code lookup as the syslog-kv sibling.

conf.comment: moveit-mft / audit / jdbc-sql: direct read of MOVEit Transfer's 'log' database table (Database Collector, checkpointed on ID). Rows are already typed columns, so this pipeline does ECS shaping only, not text parsing. Shares the Action-code category lookup, Error->event.outcome mapping, Duration-to-nanoseconds conversion, TargetName gating and FolderPath/Parm1-4 capping with the syslog-kv sibling, per recommendations.direct.cribl, plus the database-only columns (FolderID, VirtualFolderID, InterfaceType) the SysLog body never carries. No Cert column exists on this table. InterfaceType is left as a raw numeric custom field - the map recommends decoding it against a vendor interface-type table but supplies none, so decoding it would be a guess.

functions.description: record parsing scope and the database-only fields this format adds
batch-rename the status:mapped/unmapped-with-custom-target columns that need no computation, including the database-only FolderID/VirtualFolderID/InterfaceType
